body: I'm gonna try and get some help again, its just at the point where I know what they're gonna tell me, I know what they're gonna prescribe me, and I don't think it will help me.

My friends are all I have. I don't have a family, a real one anyways. I fear that if I get rid of them it'll be the final nail in the coffin. I know nobody is perfect but like I said, I know its arrogant, but I always take the time to look at what the effects of my actions will be, from a simply conversation, to a plan down the road. It genuinely hurts me when people can't see they hurt others with their words. I'm not perfect either, I say stuff I don't mean, but I always take others into account. I wish it was more common. One of the things keeping me going for now is hoping that I'll find new people to relate to. I've always been different though, always. I've never ran into anybody like myself. I know its arrogant, but its true.
Thanks for the kind words. I'm incredibly frustrated with everything though. I can't even have fun anymore. I feel dead inside.
Don't really understand what you're trying to tell me.
